title: Left Canted Vertical Stabilizer
label: SOURCED
summary: Outward-canted (28°) left vertical tail fin aligned with the wing planform sweep to eliminate 90° radar corner reflections.
role: Provides directional stability and houses the left rudder and internal antennas.
materials: Composite skins over multi-spar structural box.
